companyContext: Nintendo is a Japanese multinational video game company headquartered in Kyoto, Japan. Founded in 1889, it develops, publishes, and manufactures both video games and video game consoles. Nintendo aims to deliver unique, intuitive entertainment experiences for everyone, manufacturing and marketing video game devices such as the Nintendo Switch family of systems, developing and operating applications for smart devices, and collaborating with partners on a range of other entertainment initiatives including visual content and theme parks. Nintendo has sold more than 5.6 billion video games and over 800 million hardware units globally.
brandContext: Nintendo Switch is Nintendo's hybrid home/handheld gaming console brand, originally launched in March 2017 as a revolutionary two-in-one device that can be used in both handheld and TV-connected modes. The brand has since expanded to include the Nintendo Switch Lite, Switch OLED, and the successor Nintendo Switch 2 (launched 2025). In the context of the upcoming Nintendo Direct event, the brand showcases upcoming first- and third-party titles for both Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 systems. The next major general Nintendo Direct is anticipated for late April or June 2026, expected to focus heavily on the second half of 2026 and beyond for the Switch 2 lineup, including rumored titles such as a Star Fox game and a Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

brandVision: Nintendo Switch's vision is to redefine how, where, and when people play video games by offering a seamless hybrid gaming experience that transitions between home console and portable handheld modes. With the Nintendo Switch 2, the brand continues to evolve with improved performance, innovative Joy-Con controllers with magnetic attachment, and backward compatibility, while Nintendo Direct events serve as the primary vehicle for revealing upcoming games and building community excitement around the platform's growing library.
brandValues: Nintendo's core brand values center on putting smiles on the faces of everyone they touch, creating new surprises for people across the world to enjoy together. The Nintendo Switch brand embodies innovation through its hybrid play concept, inclusivity by providing products and services enjoyable by people of all ages and abilities, creativity through unique entertainment experiences, and a commitment to fun and quality that has defined Nintendo for over 130 years. The brand values playfulness, accessibility, family-friendly gaming, and the joy of shared experiences.
